>
[Lodestone Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2824)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 234

**Price** 1,350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _moderate reinforcing cold iron_ shield (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) is inset with lodestones that draw ammunition toward it.

**Activate—Attact Projectile** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** A ranged weapon Strike targets a creature within 15 feet of you when you have this shield raised, and the atack hasn't yet rolled their attack;  **Effect** The triggering Strike targets you instead of its normal target. If it hits, you gain the effects of the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
